title: Current
subtitle: 「目前的／現行的／當前的」，本課只處理時間狀態義，不處理名詞 current = 電流／水流／氣流。
description: 「目前的／現行的／當前的」，本課只處理時間狀態義，不處理名詞 current = 電流／水流／氣流。

words.example: The present system will remain in place until next year.
words.exampleZh: 現行制度會維持至明年。

exercises.original: The current system will remain in place until next year.
exercises.zh: 現行制度會維持至明年。
exercises.upgrade: The present system will remain in place until next year.

options.explanation: system currently in place 可自然改寫成 present system。
modern 只表示較現代，不代表現在採用。
系統可能已用了很多年，current 不等於新。
recent system 不自然，也只表示近期。

exercises.original: Under the current arrangements, staff work two days from home.
exercises.zh: 按現時安排，員工每週兩天在家工作。
exercises.upgrade: Under the present arrangements, staff work two days from home.

options.explanation: present arrangements 是目前生效安排的自然表達。
安排未必是一連串版本中的最新一個。
近期安排未必仍然有效。

exercises.original: The current situation is more stable than it was last month.
exercises.zh: 目前情況比上月穩定。
exercises.upgrade: The present situation is more stable than it was last month.

options.explanation: present situation 直接對應現在狀態。
不能形容這種短期情況。
recent situation 不等於目前仍存在。

words.example: The proposal would replace the existing rules.
words.exampleZh: 這項建議會取代現有規則。

exercises.original: The proposal would replace the current rules.
exercises.zh: 這項建議會取代現有規則。
exercises.upgrade: The proposal would replace the existing rules.

options.explanation: replace the rules already in existence，existing 最清楚。
被取代的通常不是新規則。
近期制定不等於目前存在。
可能是最新規則，但原句只保證現有。

exercises.original: Current customers will keep their original price.
exercises.zh: 現有客戶會維持原價。
exercises.upgrade: Existing customers will keep their original price.

options.explanation: 指已經是客戶的人，和新客戶形成自然對比。
近期加入的客戶只是 existing customers 的一部分。
與 existing 對比，會改變意思。

exercises.original: The new software must work with current equipment.
exercises.zh: 新軟件必須和現有設備兼容。
exercises.upgrade: The new software must work with existing equipment.

options.explanation: equipment already present 是兼容性要求的核心。
現代設備不一定就是現場已有設備。
最近購入未必涵蓋所有設備。
描述使用期限，不是『現有』。

words.example: Present-day technology makes remote work much easier.
words.exampleZh: 現今科技令遙距工作容易得多。

exercises.original: Current technology makes remote work much easier.
exercises.zh: 現今科技令遙距工作容易得多。
exercises.upgrade: Present-day technology makes remote work much easier.

options.explanation: 泛指現今時代的科技水平，適合和過去作背景比較。
科技不是以暫時性分類。
只涵蓋最近出現的技術，太窄。
需要特定產品／版本，原句是整體科技。

exercises.original: The book compares ancient law with current legal practice.
exercises.zh: 本書比較古代法律和現今法律實務。
exercises.upgrade: The book compares ancient law with present-day legal practice.

options.explanation: ancient vs current 是跨時代比較，present-day 最自然。
legal practice 不是單一最新版本。

exercises.original: Current society relies heavily on digital communication.
exercises.zh: 現今社會高度依賴數碼通訊。
exercises.upgrade: Present-day society relies heavily on digital communication.

options.explanation: society 作宏觀時代描述，present-day 很自然。
society 不是一個剛發生的事件。

words.meaning: 當代的；現代的；同時期的
words.example: The course examines contemporary social issues.
words.exampleZh: 課程探討當代社會議題。

exercises.original: The course examines current social issues.
exercises.zh: 課程探討當代社會議題。
exercises.upgrade: The course examines contemporary social issues.

options.explanation: social issues in the present era 很自然用 contemporary。
只指最最近的議題，過窄。
近期出現未必仍是當代核心議題。

exercises.original: The museum focuses on current art and design.
exercises.zh: 博物館聚焦當代藝術與設計。
exercises.upgrade: The museum focuses on contemporary art and design.

options.explanation: contemporary art 是固定而自然的文化術語。
藝術領域不是單一最新版本。
只是近期創作，不等於 contemporary art 這個領域概念。

exercises.original: The article discusses current approaches to urban planning.
exercises.zh: 文章討論當代城市規劃方法。
exercises.upgrade: The article discusses contemporary approaches to urban planning.

options.explanation: approaches in the present period 可自然用 contemporary。
modern 可能涵蓋更長歷史時期，未必特指當下。
不保證現在仍具代表性。

words.example: The report summarises the ongoing investigation.
words.exampleZh: 報告總結仍在進行中的調查。

exercises.original: The report summarises the current investigation.
exercises.zh: 報告總結仍在進行中的調查。
exercises.upgrade: The report summarises the ongoing investigation.

options.explanation: investigation still continuing 是 ongoing 的典型語境。
latest investigation 可能只是最近一宗，不表示仍在進行。
新調查也可能已結束或剛開始，沒有持續含義。

exercises.original: Current discussions with the union will continue next week.
exercises.zh: 目前與工會的討論下週仍會繼續。
exercises.upgrade: Ongoing discussions with the union will continue next week.

options.explanation: will continue next week 直接表示討論仍在進行。
最近的討論可能已結束。
描述期限，不等於進行中。

exercises.original: The organisation is dealing with a current problem that has not yet been resolved.
exercises.zh: 機構正處理一個仍未解決的問題。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation is dealing with an ongoing problem that has not yet been resolved.

options.explanation: not yet resolved 表示問題仍持續。

words.meaning: 最新的；已更新的；符合現況的
words.example: Please make sure your contact details are up-to-date.
words.exampleZh: 請確保你的聯絡資料是最新的。

exercises.original: Please make sure your current contact details are correct.
exercises.zh: 請確保你的最新聯絡資料正確。
exercises.upgrade: Please make sure your contact details are up-to-date.

options.explanation: contact details 要反映最新狀態，這裡比 current 更自然。
聯絡資料沒有『現代風格』之分。
recently changed 不保證現在正確。

exercises.original: The database should contain current information about all suppliers.
exercises.zh: 資料庫應包含所有供應商的最新資料。
exercises.upgrade: The database should contain up-to-date information about all suppliers.

options.explanation: database information 應已更新到目前狀態。

exercises.original: Users need current software to receive security fixes.
exercises.zh: 使用者需要已更新的軟件才能取得安全修正。
exercises.upgrade: Users need up-to-date software to receive security fixes.

options.explanation: security fixes 要求軟件維持最新更新狀態。
現代軟件也可能版本過舊。
最近安裝不代表已更新。

words.example: The latest version includes several security fixes.
words.exampleZh: 最新版本包含數項安全修正。

exercises.original: The current version includes several security fixes.
exercises.zh: 最新版本包含數項安全修正。
exercises.upgrade: The latest version includes several security fixes.

options.explanation: version 序列中最最近的一版，latest 最精準。
已存在的版本可能有很多個。

exercises.original: The current figures show a fall in unemployment.
exercises.zh: 最新數字顯示失業率下降。
exercises.upgrade: The latest figures show a fall in unemployment.

options.explanation: figures 通常指最近發布的一組數據。
所有已存在數據不一定是最新。

exercises.original: Read the current report before the meeting.
exercises.zh: 會議前閱讀最新報告。
exercises.upgrade: Read the latest report before the meeting.

options.explanation: 多份報告中要求讀最最近一份。
太廣，可能有很多舊報告。
報告本身不會通常說仍在進行。

words.meaning: 現行的；普遍存在的；盛行的
words.example: The policy reflects prevailing attitudes toward data privacy.
words.exampleZh: 該政策反映現時普遍存在的資料私隱觀念。

exercises.original: The policy reflects current attitudes toward data privacy.
exercises.zh: 政策反映目前普遍存在的資料私隱觀念。
exercises.upgrade: The policy reflects prevailing attitudes toward data privacy.

options.explanation: attitudes 是社會上現時普遍／主導的看法。
態度不是單一最新版本。

exercises.original: Workers are paid according to current market rates.
exercises.zh: 員工按現行市場水平獲薪。
exercises.upgrade: Workers are paid according to prevailing market rates.

options.explanation: market rates 常用 prevailing 表示現時市場通行水平。
最新報價未必等於市場普遍水平。

exercises.original: The design follows current practice in the industry.
exercises.zh: 設計遵循業界現行普遍做法。
exercises.upgrade: The design follows prevailing practice in the industry.

options.explanation: practice in the industry 表示現時占主導／普遍做法。
最近出現的做法未必已成主流。

words.meaning: 現行有效的；正在生效的
words.example: The current regulations remain in force until December.
words.exampleZh: 現行規例會有效至十二月。

exercises.original: The current regulations remain valid until December.
exercises.zh: 現行規例有效至十二月。
exercises.upgrade: The regulations currently in force remain valid until December.

options.explanation: regulations + valid 是法律效力語境的固定表達。
規例可以現代但未必有效。

exercises.original: The current law requires employers to keep these records.
exercises.zh: 現行法律要求僱主保存這些紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: The law now in force requires employers to keep these records.

options.explanation: law + legal requirement 表示目前具有法律效力。
最新通過的法律可能尚未生效。
法律可能臨時或永久，與 current 無關。

exercises.original: The agreement is current and legally binding.
exercises.zh: 該協議目前有效並具法律約束力。
exercises.upgrade: The agreement is in force and legally binding.

options.explanation: legally binding 直接指有效狀態。

words.example: The incumbent chair will remain in office until March.
words.exampleZh: 現任主席會留任至三月。

exercises.original: The current chair will remain in office until March.
exercises.zh: 現任主席會留任至三月。
exercises.upgrade: The incumbent chair will remain in office until March.

options.explanation: chair + remain in office 是現任職位語境。
不能把人稱為 latest chair 作一般現任義。
是否臨時任職和是否現任是不同概念。

exercises.original: The current mayor is seeking another term.
exercises.zh: 現任市長正爭取連任。
exercises.upgrade: The incumbent mayor is seeking another term.

options.explanation: seeking another term 的人正是現任 office-holder。
現任市長可能已任職多年。
前任不能以現任身份尋求 another term（除非另有語境）。

exercises.original: The current government has held office for three years.
exercises.zh: 現屆政府已執政三年。
exercises.upgrade: The incumbent government has held office for three years.

options.explanation: held office 是在任政府的正式語境。
latest government 不如 incumbent 精準。
現任政府可長期或臨時，概念不同。

words.meaning: 現用的；有效中的；活躍中的
words.example: Only active subscriptions receive the monthly update.
words.exampleZh: 只有目前有效的訂閱才會收到每月更新。

exercises.original: Only current subscriptions receive the monthly update.
exercises.zh: 只有目前有效的訂閱才會收到每月更新。
exercises.upgrade: Only active subscriptions receive the monthly update.

options.explanation: subscriptions 是否仍啟用／有效，active 最精準。
已過期／之前訂閱不符合。
最近開通不等於仍然有效。

exercises.original: The system displays only current user accounts.
exercises.zh: 系統只顯示目前啟用的使用者帳戶。
exercises.upgrade: The system displays only active user accounts.

options.explanation: account status 是否啟用是 active 的標準用法。
最近建立未必目前啟用。

exercises.original: Current cases are reviewed every Monday.
exercises.zh: 目前仍在處理中的個案每週一檢視。
exercises.upgrade: Active cases are reviewed every Monday.

options.explanation: cases 仍開放／處理中時常稱 active cases。

words.meaning: 目前使用中的；現時採用的
words.example: The system now in use was introduced three years ago.
words.exampleZh: 目前使用中的系統是三年前引入的。

exercises.original: The current system was introduced three years ago.
exercises.zh: 目前使用中的系統是三年前引入的。
exercises.upgrade: The system now in use was introduced three years ago.

options.explanation: introduced three years ago 證明它不一定新，但現在仍在使用。
可能另有更新系統已開發但尚未採用。
三年前引入未必仍算新。
和 now in use 相反。

exercises.original: The current form must be used for all new applications.
exercises.zh: 所有新申請都必須使用目前採用的表格。
exercises.upgrade: The form now in use must be used for all new applications.

options.explanation: must be used 表示目前正式採用的表格。
最近製作不等於正式採用。

exercises.original: The current method is simpler than the one it replaced.
exercises.zh: 目前使用的方法比被它取代的方法簡單。
exercises.upgrade: The method now in use is simpler than the one it replaced.

options.explanation: the one it replaced 明確建立現用 vs 舊方法的對比。
現用方法未必是全球最新。

words.meaning: 按目前情況；就現況而言
words.example: As things stand, the project is still within budget.
words.exampleZh: 按目前情況，項目仍然沒有超出預算。

exercises.original: In the current situation, the project is still within budget.
exercises.zh: 按目前情況，項目仍然沒有超出預算。
exercises.upgrade: As things stand, the project is still within budget.

options.explanation: 這是 current situation 的自然句子層級改寫。
只表示不久前，不保證現在仍如此。
會加入『只是暫時』，原句沒有。

exercises.original: Given the current position, no further action is needed.
exercises.zh: 按現況而言，目前毋須進一步行動。
exercises.upgrade: As things stand, no further action is needed.

options.explanation: current position 在決策語境可自然轉成『按目前情況』。

exercises.original: The current outlook suggests that demand will remain stable.
exercises.zh: 按目前情況，前景顯示需求會保持穩定。
exercises.upgrade: As things stand, demand is expected to remain stable.

options.explanation: current outlook 的語義是按現有資訊作目前判斷。
句子雖談預測，但依據是現在狀況，不能只改成 future。

falseSynonyms.zh: 現代的 不等於 current modern 通常指較新的時代／風格，並不保證是目前正在使用或存在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Modern refers to a recent era or style; current means present now.

falseSynonyms.zh: 新的 不等於 current new 強調新近產生；current 可以已經存在多年，只是現在仍在使用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something current need not be new.

falseSynonyms.zh: latest 和 current 常重疊，但不是完全同義 latest 是序列中最最近的一個；current 是現在有效／使用的一個。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The latest version may not yet be the current production version.

falseSynonyms.zh: 最近的 不等於 current recent 指不久前發生；current 指現在仍然存在／有效。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A recent event may already be over; a current event is happening now.

falseSynonyms.zh: 未來的 和 current 相反 future 指尚未發生／尚未生效；current 指現在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Future is prospective; current is present.

falseSynonyms.zh: 之前的 和 current 不同 previous 指當前之前的一個版本、職位或時段。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Previous comes before the current one.

falseSynonyms.zh: 臨時的 不等於 current temporary 描述持續時間短；current 描述時間位置，現行安排可以是永久的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A current arrangement may be temporary or permanent.

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意同形異義詞：電流 current 作名詞可指電流、水流、氣流；本課處理的是形容詞『目前的／現行的』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Electrical current and the adjective current are different senses.
